ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 60% low-intensity pixels concentrated in the central region and 40% high-intensity pixels on the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized contiguous low-intensity (black) pigment spanning the notch and inner lobes. High-intensity (white) regions occupy the lateral and distal portions of both lobes, featuring a sparse distribution of low-intensity speckles and mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a narrow vertex angle and significant vertical depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth linear boundary with low-amplitude irregularities. Distal tips exhibit high-frequency pixel jaggedness due to localized epibiont clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel groups at the extreme distal tips (consistent with barnacle colonization). Scattered, faint circular ring-marks visible within the central dark pigment.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, thin, dark linear streaks present on the white surfaces of both lobes; notably a long diagonal abrasion on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive accumulation of high-contrast epibionts (barnacles) on the lobe tips; circular pitting/scarring visible in the mid-fluke dark pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Sharp, high-contrast transition boundary between the central dark pigmentation and the lateral white pigmentation.
